notes: pose is the clip name — idle, grip, fire, later walk frames. Hangar lives in hangar_image.
origin is the socket attach point in trimmed frame local pixels
sole is foot-line y for legs; null on head/arms/weapons
flipX true means reuse the opposite side frame; do not use on blade hands
two-hand kits include armL and armR frames; weapon frames carry gripL and gripR
trim transparent borders when packing; 1px pad between frames
